issue_symptoms: curled leaves;yellowing;small white insects on underside;sticky honeydew;sooty mould
application: Foliar spray on both sides of leaves
precautions: Wear mask and gloves;Spray in early morning or evening;Avoid during peak flowering;Do not mix with chemical fungicides
notes_en: Effective on whitefly nymphs and adults; safe for pollinators when sprayed in low-light hours.

issue_symptoms: concentric ring spots on lower leaves;yellow halo;defoliation from bottom upward
application: Soil drench around root zone + light foliar spray
precautions: Store cool and dry;Do not mix with chemical fungicides;Use within 6 months of opening
notes_en: Trichoderma colonises root zone and outcompetes Alternaria. Apply with adequate soil moisture.

precautions: Avoid mixing with chemical fungicides;Spray in evening for fungal viability;Wear mask and gloves
notes_en: Beauveria bassiana infects thrips through cuticle; needs humidity to act.

precautions: Hang traps above canopy;Replace lures on schedule;Empty trap weekly
notes_en: Pheromone trap monitors and mass-traps adult moths. Pair with Bt-Bio for early-instar larvae.

issue_symptoms: hopper burn (circular yellowing patches);drying of plants;insects at plant base
application: Direct spray at plant base;maintain water film
precautions: Spray in evening hours;maintain field water;wear mask and gloves
notes_en: Metarhizium infects BPH at plant base; organic and resistance-friendly.
